summary.en: L4 and L6 are different orders of reality.
summary.fr: L4 et L6 sont d'ordres de réalité différents.
summary.ar: L4 وL6 رتبتان مختلفتان من الواقع.

description.en: A position paper, not a settled finding.

grand.en: L4 nation and L6 country are different orders of reality.

lead.en: A summary of the founder's declaration, with its declared limits shown open. This is a position paper, not a settled finding.

value.en: The supranational layer: a form of belonging, prior to any border. W5D's stated goal is to develop it and to arrive at three macro-regional identities that together complete the one human identity.
A bordered administrative artefact. The founder's position is that the term is historically recent and was created by a political ideology to make borders.

text.en: Nation is generative and fifth-dimensional. Country is administrative and fourth-dimensional.

lead.en: The target is three macro-regional identities. None has been named in the supplied material.

body.en: (1) The claim that "country" is a recent term created by a political ideology to make borders is a position, not a settled finding; the historiography of the state system is contested.
(2) The target of three macro-regional identities is a design goal, not a prediction, and it is falsifiable: if two, four or seven prove more coherent, the framework must be corrected.
(3) The claim that L4 is prior to L6 is ontological, not chronological.
(4) The link between borders and punishment is an analogy of invariant, not an identity of mechanism.

text.en: Transition: borders may be superseded by a layer that makes them redundant, not abolished by force.
